# Load libaries and data files
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(here)
library(ggpattern)

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

# Net data (Net data available upon request)
load("data/hydrobios_net_calanus_20260321.RData")
# UVP indiv data (generated from script file 4-*.Rmd)
load("data/profile_integrated_cflux_20260511.RData")

theme_set(theme_bw() +
            theme(text = element_text(size=14)))

clrs <- c("firebrick","#FF6800","#FFB300","forestgreen", "blue1","purple2","#F6768E")
```


# Species composition of nets by region
```{r}
# Calculate net integrated abundance and biomass
species.comp.region <- calanus %>%
  group_by(YEAR_STATION, STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START,
           TAXON_ID) %>% 
  summarise(total_abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2),
            mean_abundance_m3 = weighted.mean(abundance_m3, w = Depth_range),
            total_indiv_count = sum(indiv_count),
            maxDepth = max(MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH),
            nbins = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  left_join(uvp_net_match %>% 
              distinct(STATION_NAME, reg.inuk),
            by = "STATION_NAME") %>% 
  group_by(reg.inuk, TAXON_ID) %>% 
  summarise(mean_total_abund_m2 = mean(total_abundance_m2),
            mean_mean_abund_m3 = mean(mean_abundance_m3),
            n = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(TAXON_ID = case_match(TAXON_ID,
                               "Calanus finmarchicus" ~ "C.fin CV-F",
                               "Calanus glacialis" ~ "C.gla CIV-F",
                               "Calanus hyperboreus" ~ "C.hyp CIV-F"))

# Used in Fig 3b
ggplot(species.comp.region, aes(x = reg.inuk, y = mean_total_abund_m2,
                                fill = TAXON_ID)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray10","gray90","gray50"),
                    name = "Calanus\nspecies",
                    guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE) )+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1), 
                     labels = c(0,25,50,75,100),
                     expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  ylab("% Abundance") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())

```

# Compare net and uvp abundances
```{r}
comp_uvp_net <- df.profile %>% 
  select(station_year, uvp_abundance_m2 = abundance_m2, 
         region.inuktitut:bottom_depth_m) %>% 
  left_join(uvp_net_match %>% 
              select(station_year, STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START),
            by = "station_year") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(STATION_NAME)) %>% 
  
  # join net abundance
  left_join(net.integ %>% 
              select(STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START,
                     net_abundance_m2 = total_abundance_m2),
            by = join_by(STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START)) %>% 
  
  # calculate abundance difference
  mutate(rel_diff_net = (net_abundance_m2 - uvp_abundance_m2) / net_abundance_m2) %>%
  mutate(net_factor = net_abundance_m2/uvp_abundance_m2)

# Median 1.4x conversion of UVP to net abundance
summary(comp_uvp_net$net_factor)
summary(comp_uvp_net$rel_diff_net)

# major axis regression to check bias 
# slope >1, accelerating (overestimation by UVP at high abundance), underestimation at low
reg.model <- lmodel2::lmodel2(log10(net_abundance_m2) ~ log10(uvp_abundance_m2), 
           data = comp_uvp_net)
sma <- reg.model$regression.results[reg.model$regression.results$Method == "SMA", ]
10^(sma$Intercept)*100 # average multiplicative bias factor

# *** For the CI area in the figure **
# SMA slope CI from lmodel2 output
sma_ci <- reg.model$confidence.intervals[ reg.model$confidence.intervals$Method == "SMA",]
# Means on the fitted (log10) scale
xbar <- mean(log10(comp_uvp_net$uvp_abundance_m2), na.rm = TRUE)
ybar <- mean(log10(comp_uvp_net$net_abundance_m2), na.rm = TRUE)
# Fitted slope/intercept
b1 <- sma$Slope
b0 <- ybar - b1 * xbar
# CI slopes
b1_lo <- sma_ci$`2.5%-Slope`
b1_hi <- sma_ci$`97.5%-Slope`
# Corresponding intercepts so each CI line passes through the centroid
b0_lo <- ybar - b1_lo * xbar
b0_hi <- ybar - b1_hi * xbar
# x grid on original scale
x_seq <- 10^seq(log10(min(comp_uvp_net$uvp_abundance_m2, na.rm = TRUE)),
                log10(max(comp_uvp_net$uvp_abundance_m2, na.rm = TRUE)),
                length.out = 200)
# Build fitted and CI lines back on original scale
line_df <- data.frame(uvp_abundance_m2 = x_seq,
                      fit = 10^(b0 + b1 * log10(x_seq)),
                      lo  = 10^(b0_lo + b1_lo * log10(x_seq)),
                      hi  = 10^(b0_hi + b1_hi * log10(x_seq)))


# Used in Fig 3c
ggplot(comp_uvp_net, aes(x = uvp_abundance_m2, 
                         y = net_abundance_m2)) +
  geom_abline() +
  geom_ribbon(data = line_df,
              aes(x = uvp_abundance_m2, ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
              inherit.aes = FALSE,
              alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(data = line_df,
            aes(x = uvp_abundance_m2, y = fit),
            linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(color = region.inuktitut), size = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = b1, slope = b0, 
              linetype = "dashed") +
  
  geom_point(aes(color = region.inuktitut),
             size = 2) +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs,
                     name = "Region") +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  xlab("UVP6 abundance (# m⁻²)") + 
  ylab("Hydrobios abundance (# m⁻²)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Export comparison results for figure 3b
```{r}
reg.model

save(comp_uvp_net, species.comp.region, 
     reg.model, line_df, b0, b1,
     file = "data/comparison_net_uvp_abundance_20260508.RData")
```
